title: Mixed Event — My Color! — Episode8 Finding Oneself

meta.Event Outline: The MORE MORE JUMP! livestream kicks off to a great start! Things are going smoothly, until Shizuku's fear becomes a reality. Shizuku must reevaluate her past and present self in order to arrive at her ultimate decision.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah. Sorry about that.
You were all doing fine and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
There's no need to apologize.
You were doing great, Minori, so let's keep going!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Man, this looks super tough.>
<I'd be dead in ten minutes.>
<Can you really master this in a day?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Idols are all about determination! This is only the beginning and we're gonna utterly master this dance!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Next, I step in behind Airi and...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't sweat it. Let's try it again!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Whoa? She messed up again?>
<Hold on, is Airi actually a better dancer than Shizuku?>
<Wasn't expecting that...>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone seems pretty tired. Maybe we should take a breather...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree...
Please, take a break.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm going to keep practicing a little more.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Don't worry about me. I'll only be a little longer.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't worry. Shizuku's always been like this.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She struggles so much at the beginning, but ends up putting in even more effort when nobody's looking.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's how she gradually becomes the perfect Shizuku everyone sees on stage.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I want to see Shizuku's solo practice!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I don't like seeing her trip and fall this much but...>
<I want to see too! Can you show us?!>
<Point the camera at Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right...! I feel a little bad for doing this without asking, but I'm sure Shizuku will understand.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Then let's just rotate the camera this way and...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She's been working this hard behind the scenes?>
<She always looks so composed. I wasn't expecting this.>
<She looks so determined! lol.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I always thought she was just perfect at everything.>
<I guess it makes sense that she works this hard.>
<It's so different from what I imagined...>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Seeing how much effort she puts into becoming the perfect Shizuku we all know is actually pretty moving.>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Watching her like this makes me want to work even harder too.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sorry, I was concentrating so much that I lost track of time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I think that should do it.
I think I can manage now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, okay....
Show us what you can do!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want to show my fans that I can do this...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I don't want anyone to regret supporting me up to this point! I may not be perfect, but I still want to give them hope!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I... I finished the whole thing...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Great job, everyone.
We made it through the entire routine.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line:
N-No more...
I can't move a muscle.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's give her a chance to catch her breath. She did great considering we just threw her into the deep end with such a brutal song.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I agree.
Minori really is amazing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She is... But I think today's MVP is you, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, wasn't there something you wanted to say to our viewers?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone... There's something I would like to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe the idol I was as part of Cheerful*Days was a much better idol than I am today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, that version of me was only made possible thanks to all the support she had. She wasn't the true me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure you would all rather see the old version of me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
However... I'm sorry.
I can no longer be her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: While I may not be able to give you the perfect version of myself you were all hoping for...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still going to try my very best to inspire everyone.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So please... If you'll have me, I would very much like it if you would continue to support me.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <I'll love any version of you, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Thank you for being so honest!>
<You'll always have my support!>
<Not what I was expecting, but you've got my support.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Going forward, we'd like to show you all a new side of ourselves. As members of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We promise to work even harder than before to live up to your expectations. We look forward to your support!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I can't wait!>
<I'll be cheering for you!>
<Let's all do our best, together!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku! Good job!
You got through it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I couldn't have done it without you all.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line: Huh? But I didn't do anything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The fact that you supported me and said you like me just the way I am is what gave me the strength to make this decision.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You gave me the courage I needed, Minori.
Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Minori.
rows.Line:
I-If you say so...
I'm just glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, Shizuku! Let's re-watch the stream!
We got tons of great comments!
